import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, collections
AAs='ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV'; AI={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
BM=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in """4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3

0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1

-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2

-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4""".split('\n')],float)
GO,GE=-11.,-1.
def nw(a,b):
    ia=np.array([AI.get(c,0) for c in a]); ib=np.array([AI.get(c,0) for c in b])
    S=BM[ia[:,None],ib[None,:]]
    m,n=len(a),len(b); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((m+1,n+1),NEG);Ix=M.copy();Iy=M.copy();tb=np.zeros((m+1,n+1,3),np.int8);M[0,0]=0
    ar=np.arange(1,m+1); M[0,0]=0
    Ix[1:,0]=GO+GE*(ar-1); tb[1:,0,1]=1
    Iy[0,1:]=GO+GE*(np.arange(1,n+1)-1); tb[0,1:,2]=2
    for i in range(1,m+1):
        M0,X0,Y0=M[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1]
        st=np.stack([M0[:-1],X0[:-1],Y0[:-1]]); k=st.argmax(0)
        M[i,1:]=st[k,np.arange(n)]+S[i-1]; tb[i,1:,0]=k
        st=np.stack([M0[1:]+GO,X0[1:]+GE,Y0[1:]+GO]); k=st.argmax(0)
        Ix[i,1:]=st[k,np.arange(n)]; tb[i,1:,1]=k
        Mi,Xi,Yi=M[i],Ix[i],Iy[i]
        for j in range(1,n+1):
            v=(Mi[j-1]+GO,Xi[j-1]+GO,Yi[j-1]+GE); kk=int(np.argmax(v)); Yi[j]=v[kk]; tb[i,j,2]=kk
    i,j=m,n;st=int(np.argmax([M[m,n],Ix[m,n],Iy[m,n]]));best=float(max(M[m,n],Ix[m,n],Iy[m,n]));pa=[];qa=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: pa.append(None);qa.append(j-1);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: pa.append(i-1);qa.append(None);i-=1;continue
        if st==0: pa.append(i-1);qa.append(j-1);ns=tb[i,j,0];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: pa.append(i-1);qa.append(None);ns=tb[i,j,1];i-=1
        else: pa.append(None);qa.append(j-1);ns=tb[i,j,2];j-=1
        st=int(ns)
    pa.reverse();qa.reverse(); return best,pa,qa
def fetch(a): return ''.join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
REF={'Yet1':fetch('P35723'),'Yet2':fetch('Q04210'),'Yet3':fetch('Q07451')}
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
   params={'query':'xref:pfam-PF05529 AND taxonomy_id:4751','fields':'accession,organism_name,length,gene_names,sequence','format':'tsv','size':'500'},timeout=90)
rows=[l.split('\t') for l in r.text.strip().split('\n')][1:]
rows=[x for x in rows if len(x)>=5 and set(x[4])<=set(AAs)]
Lf=np.array([len(x[4]) for x in rows])
print('fungal PF05529 n=%d; length percentile: Yet2(160)=%.1f Yet3(203)=%.1f Yet1(206)=%.1f'%(
    len(rows),(Lf<160).mean()*100,(Lf<203).mean()*100,(Lf<206).mean()*100))
def kv(s,k=3): return collections.Counter(s[i:i+k] for i in range(len(s)-k+1))
def cos(c1,c2):
    return sum(c1[k]*c2[k] for k in c1 if k in c2)/(np.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in c1.values()))*np.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in c2.values()))+1e-9)
KR={k:kv(v) for k,v in REF.items()}
cands=sorted(rows,key=lambda x:-cos(kv(x[4]),KR['Yet2']))[:22]
grp=[]
for x in cands:
    if x[0]=='Q04210': continue
    sc={k:nw(REF[k],x[4])[0] for k in REF}
    if max(sc,key=sc.get)=='Yet2': grp.append((x,sc))
print(f"\nYet2-type fungal orthologues identified: n={len(grp)}  median length {np.median([len(x[4]) for x,_ in grp]):.0f}")
for x,sc in grp:
    print(f"  {x[0]:8s} {x[1][:40]:42s} len={x[3]:>4s} Yet1={sc['Yet1']:5.0f} Yet2={sc['Yet2']:5.0f} Yet3={sc['Yet3']:5.0f} Cterm={x[4][-6:]}")
CORE={131:'N',134:'M',138:'D',141:'L',145:'L',148:'K',152:'L',155:'L'}
cons={p:[] for p in CORE}
for x,_ in grp:
    _,pa,qa=nw(REF['Yet2'],x[4]); pos={}
    for ia,ib in zip(pa,qa):
        if ia is not None: pos[ia+1]=x[4][ib] if ib is not None else '-'
    for p in CORE: cons[p].append(pos.get(p,'-'))
tab=[{'Yet2_pos':f"{aa}{p}",'pct_identical':round(cons[p].count(aa)/len(cons[p])*100,1),
      'pct_hydrophobic':round(sum(1 for c in cons[p] if c in 'AVLIMFWC')/len(cons[p])*100,1),
      'top3':collections.Counter(cons[p]).most_common(3)} for p,aa in CORE.items()]
cdf=pd.DataFrame(tab); print("\nConservation in Yet2-type orthologues at the core positions Yet2p retains:")
print(cdf.to_string(index=False)); cdf.to_csv('/tmp/fungal_cons.csv',index=False)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax[0].hist(Lf,bins=45,color='#c8c8c8',label=f'all fungal PF05529 (n={len(Lf)})')
ax[0].hist([len(x[4]) for x,_ in grp],bins=14,color='#c0504d',alpha=.9,label=f'Yet2-type (n={len(grp)})')
for v,c,l in [(160,'crimson','Yet2p 160'),(203,'#2e7d32','Yet3p 203'),(206,'#4878a8','Yet1p 206')]:
    ax[0].axvline(v,color=c,ls='--',lw=2); ax[0].text(v+2,ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*.75,l,rotation=90,fontsize=8,color=c)
ax[0].set_xlabel('protein length (aa)'); ax[0].set_ylabel('count'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title('Yet2p length sits at the 2nd percentile of the fungal BAP31 family',fontsize=10)
ax[1].bar(range(len(cdf)),cdf.pct_identical,color='#4878a8',label='identical to Yet2p')
ax[1].plot(range(len(cdf)),cdf.pct_hydrophobic,'o-',color='#c0504d',label='hydrophobic (AVLIMFWC)')
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(cdf))); ax[1].set_xticklabels(cdf.Yet2_pos,fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel('% of Yet2-type orthologues'); ax[1].set_ylim(0,105); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_title('Coiled-coil core positions Yet2p retains, conservation across fungi',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
